feeds.title: Written In Stone...seen through my lens
feeds.description: Geology is all around us, scarcely thought of as we go about our lives. Yet, it affects everything we do as a civilization, as a society and as individuals. Preserving a record of creatures and landscapes both ancient and forgotten, the story of our past is written in stone and waiting to be read.
